metadata.title: Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One
metadata.thing: the packet-electron collision at the escape cost
metadata.palette_note: Bear's call (2026-07-03, after viewing): literal RED for the low-frequency light — #FC6255 (3b1b-style red, reads on the dark canvas), overriding the series no-red rule for this video only. High-frequency stays blue #58C4DD. The layout audit checks geometry only, so this is safe.
chapters: What we skipped, and your turn
metadata.long_title: Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One — the photoelectric effect | Bear's Notes
metadata.description_blurb: In this video: why a blinding red lamp frees no electrons while a dim blue one works instantly; light arriving as packets whose energy is set by color alone (E = hν); the all-or-nothing escape cost Φ; the leftover K = hν − Φ and the threshold frequency; and sodium by the numbers — where 300 nm succeeds and a ten-thousand-watt green lamp fails.
metadata.short_blurb: The photoelectric effect, from anomaly to E = hν. Full explainer on the channel.

beats.narration_text:
Bear's Notes

Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One
beats.tts_normalized_text:
Bear's Notes.

Why a Dim Blue Lamp Beats a Blinding Red One.
beats.new_visual_element: Title card: 'Bear's Notes' small, title large in EB Garamond, thin brown rule, small blue accent mark on dark canvas.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Fade in series line, beat, Write the title; draw the brown underline; blue tick fades in. Hold.

beats.narration_text: Aim the brightest red lamp you own at a metal plate — and not one electron escapes.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Aim the brightest red lamp you own at a metal plate — and not one electron escapes.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Metal plate (ink slab, right of MAIN) holding a row of blue electron dots; a lamp circle (warm amber #E07B39) at left pours long, lazy sine waves onto the plate; small ink label 'red' under the lamp. Electrons do not move.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create plate + electrons; GrowFromCenter warm lamp; Create three long-wavelength waves flowing to the plate. Electrons stay perfectly still.

beats.narration_text: Swap in a dim blue glow, and electrons fly off the instant it lands.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Swap in a dim blue glow, and electrons fly off the instant it lands.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] The warm lamp morphs into a smaller, dimmer blue lamp; waves tighten to short wavelength; two electrons leap off the plate along arcs the moment the wave arrives; label swaps to 'blue'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform lamp (warm→blue, shrink slightly), Transform waves (long→short λ); immediately two electron dots fly off with motion arcs.

beats.narration_text: Crank the red lamp up to blinding, pour on more and more light — and still, nothing.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Crank the red lamp up to blinding, pour on more and more light — and still, nothing.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] Blue lamp morphs back to the warm one, which grows large and bright; the wave count triples; a brightness dial or '×100' mono numeral appears; electrons sit stone still.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform back to warm lamp, scale up, multiply waves; '×100' (JetBrains-style mono ink) pops in; nothing on the plate moves.

beats.narration_text: Brightness is energy, so more ought to mean more — yet here it means nothing at all.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Brightness is energy, so more ought to mean more — yet here it means nothing at all.
beats.new_visual_element: [HOOK] A single highlight '?' lands beside the still electrons; the '×100' pulses once and dims.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn '?' in highlight yellow near the plate; Indicate; everything else freezes.

beats.narration_text: A wave washes its energy smoothly over every electron, so enough brightness should eventually shake any one of them loose.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A wave washes its energy smoothly over every electron, so enough brightness should eventually shake any one of them loose.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The discrete waves soften into broad concentric ripples that wash over the whole plate; a thin secondary 'energy' bar under each electron starts creeping up in unison.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform waves into wide ripple arcs sweeping the plate; tiny bars under each electron rise slowly together.

beats.narration_text: But below a certain color, no brightness and no patience ever free a single electron — so the smooth-wave picture is simply wrong here.
beats.tts_normalized_text: But below a certain color, no brightness and no patience ever free a single electron — so the smooth-wave picture is simply wrong here.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The creeping bars freeze; a hairline 'strike' crosses the ripple picture; a small secondary clock glyph fades in and out ('no patience').
beats.video_animation_prompt: Bars stop; draw a diagonal hairline strike over the ripples; clock glyph FadeIn/FadeOut; hold the failure.

beats.narration_text: So stop picturing a smooth wave, and picture light arriving as separate packets.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So stop picturing a smooth wave, and picture light arriving as separate packets.
accumulated_scene_state: stream of discrete packets crossing MAIN
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE][act break] Fresh canvas. A smooth ink wave draws, then breaks apart into a stream of discrete rounded packets marching left-to-right across MAIN.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create a long smooth wave; Transform it into a row of evenly spaced packet dots/squares that drift rightward.

beats.narration_text: Each packet carries a fixed energy set only by its color — red packets weak, blue packets strong.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Each packet carries a fixed energy set only by its color — red packets weak, blue packets strong.
accumulated_scene_state: two packets compared side by side
energy bars: small warm, tall blue
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The stream parks; one warm packet and one blue packet move to center, each above an energy bar — the warm bar short, the blue bar tall; labels 'red · weak' (ink) and 'blue · strong' (ink).
beats.video_animation_prompt: Two packets separate from the stream and enlarge; energy bars grow beneath them to different heights; labels write on.

beats.narration_text: Turn up the brightness and you get more packets per second, never fatter ones.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Turn up the brightness and you get more packets per second, never fatter ones.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The warm packet's stream densifies (many more packets per second flow by); its energy bar stays exactly the same height and flashes highlight once to say 'unchanged'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Multiply warm packets into a dense stream; Indicate the unchanged warm energy bar with the highlight color, then fade highlight.

beats.narration_text: Every electron sits in the metal behind a fixed escape cost it must be handed all at once to break free.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Every electron sits in the metal behind a fixed escape cost it must be handed all at once to break free.
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] The comparison slides aside; a well (U-shaped ink outline) appears with a blue electron resting at the bottom; the well's rim height is marked by a hairline with label 'escape cost'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Packets shrink to a corner; Create the well; electron dot drops in; hairline + 'escape cost' label write at the rim.

beats.narration_text: And a packet is swallowed whole by one electron — never shared as sips among many.
beats.tts_normalized_text: And a packet is swallowed whole by one electron — never shared as sips among many.
accumulated_scene_state: one packet absorbed whole by one electron
beats.new_visual_element: [INSTANCE] A single packet arrows into the one electron and vanishes into it (the electron blinks); a struck-through sketch of a packet splitting into shared sips fades in and out (the natural wrong picture, corrected).
beats.video_animation_prompt: Packet flies to the electron, absorbed with a blink; ghost image of 'split among many' appears with a strike and fades.

beats.narration_text: A weak red packet lands, falls short of the escape cost, and its energy just bleeds away as heat.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A weak red packet lands, falls short of the escape cost, and its energy just bleeds away as heat.
accumulated_scene_state: electron jumps partway and falls back
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] A warm packet hits; the electron rises partway up the well — visibly short of the rim hairline — then sinks back; a faint shimmer drifts off as heat.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Warm packet in; electron animates up to ~60% of rim height, pauses, falls back; small shimmer marks fade upward.

beats.narration_text: Pour on millions of red packets and every one still falls short — a flood of near-misses frees nothing.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Pour on millions of red packets and every one still falls short — a flood of near-misses frees nothing.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] A rain of warm packets, each producing the same partial hop and fall-back; a mono counter 'freed: 0' sits in the corner and never changes.
beats.video_animation_prompt: LaggedStart many warm packets; electron bobs repeatedly to the same sub-rim height; 'freed: 0' counter persists unchanged.

beats.narration_text: Now one faint blue packet lands, clears the escape cost in a single hit, and an electron flies free.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now one faint blue packet lands, clears the escape cost in a single hit, and an electron flies free.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] One blue packet arrives alone; the electron shoots over the rim hairline in a single motion and escapes along an arc; the counter ticks to 'freed: 1'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Single blue packet in; electron rises past the rim in one continuous motion, arcs away; counter morphs 0→1.

beats.narration_text: Whatever energy is left after paying the cost becomes that electron's speed.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Whatever energy is left after paying the cost becomes that electron's speed.
beats.new_visual_element: [TRANSFORM] Beside the well, the blue packet's energy bar reappears split at the rim height: the lower segment dims (paid), the top sliver highlights and morphs into a speed arrow on the escaped electron.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Energy bar splits at the cost line; the leftover top segment glows highlight and transforms into a velocity arrow attached to the free electron.

beats.narration_text: So a packet's energy is just a constant times its frequency — write it E equals h nu — and that packet of light has a name: a photon.
beats.tts_normalized_text: So a packet's energy is just a constant times its frequency — write it E equals h nu — and that packet of light has a name: a photon.
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] In the SIDE region, E = hν writes itself above the lab; the word 'photon' (ink) appears under it — the name arriving as the endpoint.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write MathTex E = h\nu in SIDE-eq row; 'photon' fades in beneath; nothing in the lab is disturbed.

beats.narration_text: An electron escapes only when h nu beats the cost, and the leftover is its kinetic energy: K equals h nu minus the escape cost.
beats.tts_normalized_text: An electron escapes only when h nu beats the cost, and the leftover is its kinetic energy: K equals h nu minus the escape cost.
accumulated_scene_state: side: E = hν and K = hν − Φ
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] Below E = hν, the ledger line K = hν − Φ writes; the Φ term briefly links (highlight underline) to the rim hairline in the well — the escape cost now has a symbol.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write K = h\nu - \Phi; a transient highlight underline ties Φ to the rim line, then fades.

beats.narration_text: Below the frequency where h nu exactly equals the cost, no packet can ever pay — that's the threshold color.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Below the frequency where h nu exactly equals the cost, no packet can ever pay — that's the threshold color.
accumulated_scene_state: side: frequency axis with threshold marker
beats.new_visual_element: [ABSTRACTION] A small horizontal frequency axis appears in SIDE below the equations: warm zone left, blue zone right, a hairline tick at the threshold labeled 'ν₀'; left of it dims.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Create short axis; tick + ν₀ label; region left of the tick drops to low opacity.

beats.narration_text: Now the mystery dissolves: brightness only counts the packets, but color decides whether any single packet can pay.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Now the mystery dissolves: brightness only counts the packets, but color decides whether any single packet can pay.
accumulated_scene_state: the two hook lamps return above the well
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] The two lamps from the hook return (warm large, blue small) above the lab; from each, packet streams at their true sizes; the '?' from the hook reappears and dissolves.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeIn both lamps with their packet streams; the hook's '?' reappears briefly and dissolves to nothing.

beats.narration_text: A blinding red lamp is a torrent of packets that each fall short; a dim blue lamp is a trickle that each clear the bar.
beats.tts_normalized_text: A blinding red lamp is a torrent of packets that each fall short; a dim blue lamp is a trickle that each clear the bar.
accumulated_scene_state: trickle of blue packets freeing electrons
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF] Side by side: dense warm torrent — every packet's hop dies below the rim; sparse blue trickle — every packet lofts an electron out. The contrast holds in silence a moment.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Run both streams simultaneously; warm side bobs and fails en masse, blue side frees one electron per packet; brief hold.

beats.narration_text: On sodium, ultraviolet at three hundred nanometers brings four point one electron volts against a two point three cost, and electrons leave with energy to spare.
beats.tts_normalized_text: On sodium, ultraviolet at three hundred nanometers brings four point one electron volts against a two point three cost, and electrons leave with energy to spare.
accumulated_scene_state: sodium card: 4.13 eV vs Φ = 2.28 eV
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF·NUMBER] A card in SIDE: 'sodium · 300 nm', mono numerals 4.13 eV against a cost line at 2.28 eV; the surplus segment glows briefly.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Card fades in; bar to 4.13 with cost hairline at 2.28; surplus above the line flashes highlight.

beats.narration_text: Slide to green, and each packet lands a hair below the cost — now not one electron leaves, not even under a ten thousand watt lamp.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Slide to green, and each packet lands a hair below the cost — now not one electron leaves, not even under a ten thousand watt lamp.
accumulated_scene_state: card morphed: 546 nm, 2.27 eV just under 2.28
beats.new_visual_element: [PAYOFF·NUMBER] The card morphs: '546 nm', bar shrinks to 2.27 eV — a hair under the 2.28 hairline; a mono '10,000 W' appears and changes nothing.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Transform card values; bar eases down to just below the cost line; '10,000 W' pops in, beat, nothing happens.

beats.narration_text: We didn't measure the constant h itself, or ask how one packet can also behave like a wave — each is its own video.
beats.tts_normalized_text: We didn't measure the constant h itself, or ask how one packet can also behave like a wave — each is its own video.
beats.new_visual_element: [BOUNDARY] Clean close: E = hν and K = hν − Φ centered; beneath, two secondary tags: 'next · measuring h', 'next · the double slit'.
beats.video_animation_prompt: Write both equations stacked; LaggedStart the two 'next ·' tags below.

beats.narration_text: Try it yourself: look up a metal's escape cost and find the longest wavelength of light that can still free an electron.
beats.tts_normalized_text: Try it yourself: look up a metal's escape cost and find the longest wavelength of light that can still free an electron.
beats.new_visual_element: [BOUNDARY] Tags fade; the equations shrink and park high; the exercise writes across the lower band in highlight.
beats.video_animation_prompt: FadeOut tags; scale equations up and small; Write the exercise line in highlight yellow.
